title: Priyamudan
desc: Vasanth, the son of a wealthy businessman, falls in love with Priya when he visits Rajasthan. He impersonates a man named Vasanth Kumar, who had saved her life before, in order to woo her.

title: Gopura Vasalile
desc: After losing his lover, teacher Manohar's life stagnates. His friends intervene, reigniting his passion for life and opening doors to new love.

title: Colour Kanavugal
desc: A happy-go-lucky man falls head over heels for a girl from a wealthy family who rebuffs his sentiments. However, the man leaves no stone unturned to win her heart.

desc: June yearns for a mother's love and affection. She helps an old lady who was hurt in an accident and decides adopt her when her own son opts to put her in an old age home.
